title: The Missing Jade Teapot
scene: Between 4:40 and 5:00 PM, the antique jade teapot vanished from the tasting counter. The pavilion has glass walls facing the garden path.

suspects.name: Maude Jenkins
suspects.testimony: I sorted oolong leaves in the garden pavilion from 4:35 to 5:05 PM, completely alone the whole time.
suspects.alibiProof: The pavilion chime stayed silent, and Linnea's view through the glass confirms Maude was alone.

suspects.name: Alistair Boyd
suspects.testimony: I was in the garden pavilion with Maude from 4:35 to 5:05 PM, helping her weigh the tea tins.
suspects.contradiction: Linnea saw Maude alone in the pavilion, and the jade teapot was wrapped inside Alistair's scarf.

suspects.name: Linnea Berg
suspects.testimony: I trimmed bonsai trees outside the pavilion window from 4:35 to 5:05 PM; only Maude was inside.
suspects.alibiProof: A tea house server brought Linnea a glass of water by the pavilion window at 4:45 and 5:00 PM.

suspects.name: Mateo Rios
suspects.testimony: I tuned my acoustic guitar on the stool right beside the tasting counter from 4:40 to 5:00 PM.
suspects.alibiProof: Three patrons listened to Mateo tuning his guitar beside the tasting counter from 4:40 to 5:00 PM.
